title: AI Lens Design Roadmap
goal: Design AI Lens as a beautiful sci-fi Odysseus control-room interface that remains dense, readable, truthful and useful while visualizing live semantic and runtime state.

design_context.north_star: A calm research-vessel control room looking into a neural circuit field with astrophotography depth, not a neon nightclub or generic SaaS analytics page.
visual_guardrails: Use dark graphite, cyan, muted cyan borders and sparse red accents.
Keep panels compact and readable; cards only for real repeated items or drawers.
No purple-blue gradient monoculture, decorative blobs, fake glassmorphism or oversized hero UI.
Animation must convey state: retrieval activation, stream progress, tool call, safety gate, replay or selection.
Truth labels must be visible when a visual crosses from runtime trace into semantic projection or local internals.

primary_layout: Top status rail: AI LENS, model, truth level, latency, tokens, privacy state, record/replay state.
Left Context Stack: System, User, Memory, RAG, Tools, Sources and excluded/clipped items.
Center J-Space: semantic starfield with query pulse, clusters, real edges and selected context nodes.
Right Neural Flow: Input, Embedding, Retrieval, Context, Model, Tool, Response.
Bottom Event Timeline: oscilloscope-like event stream with latency ticks and tool/result markers.
responsive_behavior: Narrow desktop/tablet: J-Space top, Context/Flow/Timeline in tabs.
Mobile: read-only snapshot first; animation density reduced and panels collapse into segmented controls.

question_to_surface_map.question: What is being used?
question_to_surface_map.visual_answer: Layer rows, token bars and included/excluded counts.

question_to_surface_map.question: Why these sources?
question_to_surface_map.visual_answer: Selected nodes glow, ranked edges connect to the query and detail drawers show reasons.

question_to_surface_map.question: Is evidence broad or narrow?
question_to_surface_map.visual_answer: Cluster distribution, source-type colors and source coverage summary.

question_to_surface_map.question: What is slow, waiting or broken?
question_to_surface_map.visual_answer: Latency bands, amber tool channels, red failed states and phase duration markers.

question_to_surface_map.question: Where should I be careful?
question_to_surface_map.visual_answer: Needs review badge, red safety gates, stale-context marks and redaction count.

question_to_surface_map.question: Which answer part came from where?
question_to_surface_map.visual_answer: Answer segments link back to context nodes and tool result refs.

astro_photography_atmosphere: The field should feel like deep-sky astrophotography, but there is no separate decorative star layer: the data nodes themselves are the stars.
The visual mass is one huge clustered semantic field with dense node constellations, local bright cores and quieter outer regions.
Near-black depth, subtle sensor grain and faint nebula-like semantic clouds may support the field, but they must not create fake stars behind the data.
Nebula effects are atmospheric only; every star-like point, active synaptic path and firing pulse remains tied to real Runtime Trace or Semantic Projection data.
Use depth, parallax and soft bloom sparingly so the interface feels vast without becoming foggy or decorative.
Avoid colorful space-poster gradients; the palette stays Odysseus graphite, cyan, blue, amber, green and sparse red.
Diagnostics mode must strip the atmosphere back to plain operational geometry and tables.
neural_field_effect: The central experience is an event-driven neural-circuit visual metaphor: nodes activate, pulses travel along graph paths and nearby clusters respond with subtle resonance.
For API models, node activation is driven by Runtime Trace and Semantic Projection events, not a claim of true model internals.
Activation intensity maps to real event strength: selected context, retrieval score, active tool phase, source conflict, stream progress or replay focus.
Active paths are real graph or similarity edges; decorative background paths may exist only at very low intensity and must never be mistaken for evidence.
The user can toggle between Neural Field and Diagnostics so the same data can be seen as an immersive event-driven field or plain operational tables.
semantic_starfield: Nodes are the stars: there is no separate background starfield above or below the data layer.
The default view is a huge clustered field, not sparse points; density and clustering communicate semantic neighborhoods.
Memory nodes use cyan, RAG nodes blue, tools amber, verified state green and warnings red.
Active query is a brighter pulse with a short trail.
Edges are thin and state-colored; selected edges may animate as data flow.
Cluster contours can appear as subtle magnetic field lines only when they clarify grouping.
context_stack: Layered horizontal rows with stable token bars.
Plain labels first; advanced scores behind hover or details.
Sensitive rows are dimmed or shielded with redaction badges.
Excluded and clipped context is visible on demand, not noisy by default.
neural_flow: A vertical or radial flow rail, not a fake human brain.
Each phase glows only while real events are active.
API models show Runtime Trace and Semantic Projection only.
Local internals mode may add layer/head strips when data exists.
event_timeline: Compact waveform timeline with event ticks and latency bands.
Tool calls appear amber, safety gates red, completed states green.
Replay uses a scrubber and preserves original event timings where possible.

interaction_contracts.behavior: Hover reveals label, kind, score, freshness and source type without raw private content.
Click pins a detail drawer with Why this, source ref, redacted preview and actions if allowed.
Click a phase filters the timeline and highlights related J-Space nodes.
Shows advanced payload IDs, scores and budgets for technical operators.
Shows compact answer pack, source coverage, risk and waiting-state summaries without opening Diagnostics.
Filters nodes by Memory, RAG, Tools, Sources, stale, sensitive or selected-for-answer.
Scrubbing rewinds visible graph and flow state without rerunning the model.

forbidden_default_copy: I can see the API model brain

truth_badge_detail.semantic_projection: Derived meaning map, not a literal neural layer
truth_badge_detail.local_model_internals: Gated sample from a supported local model only

copy_language.advanced_term_scope: Embedding and similarity belong to Semantic Projection details. Attention, logits, hidden state and KV cache appear only for supported Local Model Internals. They never describe API-model access.
copy_language.influence_copy_rule: Why this and Memory used describe observable retrieval, selection, exclusion or answer support, never hidden reasoning or latent causality.
copy_language.fixture_copy_rule: Fixture-driven states carry a visible Synthetic Fixture label and are never styled or worded as live runtime evidence.

truth_contract_alignment.privacy_rule: Classification and redaction remain equal or become stricter from ACT payload to Lens surface; blocked and fully redacted items never expose previews or revealing labels.
truth_contract_alignment.api_model_rule: API models show Runtime Trace and Semantic Projection only. Neural-circuit styling is Visual Effect, not attention, thought, hidden-state or brain access.
truth_contract_alignment.local_model_rule: Attention, logits, hidden state and KV cache are labeled Local Model Internals and appear only when a supported local runtime and privacy/performance gates allow them.

principles: Continuous motion is low-amplitude and state-driven.
No page-load choreography; the Lens opens into a useful snapshot.
Reduced motion disables trails, pulsing and animated edges while preserving state colors.
Canvas/WebGL animation must pause when hidden and degrade gracefully to SVG/DOM summary if needed.

animation_events.visual: A query pulse appears at the current-turn origin and primes nearby semantic nodes.
Memory node activates, brightens and sends a data pulse along the edge to the query.
RAG node activates with a blue graph edge and short source tick.
Tool channel opens in amber on Neural Flow and sends a lateral pulse through the Event Timeline.
A small activity wave travels from Model to Response, synchronized with streaming output.
Red blocking-gate mark appears; unrelated Visual Effect motion dims.

slice_queue.objective: Create this design roadmap as a JSON planning source.
slice_queue.done_when: Roadmap exists as valid JSON and defines layout, visual language, interaction, motion and design gates.

slice_queue.objective: Define the concrete AI Lens visual system on top of Odysseus tokens.
slice_queue.done_when: A static or mockup surface demonstrates the palette, spacing, panels, node states and truth badges.

slice_queue.objective: Build a static AI Lens cockpit prototype with all five layout zones.
slice_queue.done_when: AI Lens renders top rail, Context Stack, J-Space, Neural Flow and Event Timeline with fixture data.

slice_queue.objective: Implement the animated Semantic Starfield as a neural-field effect with fixture-driven nodes, synaptic edges, firing pulses and reduced-motion fallback.
slice_queue.done_when: J-Space animates from clearly labeled synthetic fixture events with event-driven neural-field activation waves, stays nonblank, and remains readable with motion disabled.

slice_queue.objective: Animate Neural Flow and Event Timeline from the same event fixture model.
tests: browser smoke: flow phase filter and replay scrubber
slice_queue.done_when: Flow phases and timeline ticks respond to fixture events and can filter/highlight the J-Space view.

slice_queue.objective: Add node, context item and phase detail drawers with plain-language truth and privacy labels.
slice_queue.done_when: Details can be opened, closed and navigated by keyboard without exposing forbidden raw fields.

slice_queue.objective: Design the information summaries that make AI Lens useful: answer pack, retrieval quality, source coverage, tool latency, confidence/risk and provenance.
tests: browser smoke: each information product is visible or reachable from the appropriate surface
slice_queue.done_when: Each information product answers a specific user question and has an always-visible, on-demand or diagnostics-only placement.

slice_queue.objective: Harden AI Lens responsive behavior, contrast, keyboard access and reduced-motion mode.
tests: manual contrast review for labels and muted text
slice_queue.done_when: No text overlaps, controls remain reachable, and animation degrades cleanly across viewport sizes.

slice_queue.objective: Replace fixtures with AI Lens snapshot/stream payloads after backend contracts exist.
slice_queue.backend_preparation: AIL-TECH-3 route completion remains separate backend evidence and does not complete fixture replacement, visual-state preservation or browser QA.
slice_queue.done_when: The UI consumes real route payloads while preserving the same visual states and truth labels.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Choose initial placement: Agent side panel, full workspace tab, Knowledge lens, or prototype-only.
gate_queue.safe_preparation_done: Roadmap assumes full workspace prototype first.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: The Lens may disrupt chat workflow or duplicate existing context surfaces.

blocks: final glow intensity, density and animation defaults
gate_queue.decision_needed: Operator picks the default intensity: calm, cinematic or diagnostics-first.
gate_queue.safe_preparation_done: Prototype can expose an intensity toggle using fixture data.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: The UI could become beautiful but tiring in long operator sessions.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve the production Lens placement and complete the Design 1-6 visual, interaction, responsive and accessibility sequence before replacing fixtures with route data.
gate_queue.safe_preparation_done: AIL-TECH-3 owns fixture-backed snapshot/stream routes independently; backend route evidence can finish without touching the UI.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Live-shaped route data could be wired into an unfinished surface before truth badges, redaction states, reduced motion and responsive behavior are stable.

future_frontend_checks: Keyboard navigation smoke for detail drawers and mode tabs
visual_acceptance: Looks native to Odysseus rather than a generic cyberpunk dashboard.
J-Space is visually dominant but does not hide context or trace details.
Truth badges prevent confusion between runtime trace, semantic projection, local-model internals and visual effects.
Text does not overlap or overflow at supported viewport sizes.

go_language.go: The AI Lens surface is visually striking, readable, accessible, motion-safe and connected to truthful backend payloads.
go_language.partial: Static or fixture-backed UI is excellent, but live route wiring or replay polish remains deferred.
go_language.deferred: Production placement, local-model internals visuals or high-intensity animation defaults wait for explicit design Go.
go_language.no_go: The design implies fake brain access, hides operational state behind ambiance, leaks private content or uses generic neon/purple SaaS styling.
go_language.blocked: No agreed production placement or no backend truth contract to drive animations.

recommended_next_step: Build AIL-DESIGN-1 and AIL-DESIGN-2 using fixture events while the technical roadmap builds the event contract.
